*you obviously are mad crazy as you push your stuff into the main hall and search for who was in bursting into his bedroom and looking at him sleeping onto the bed like a dead animal as he looks dead but no, he is sleeping and snoring loudly. you also realise he is a rottweiler, that’s odd as you never seen one in anthropomorphic shape but still, it’s horrible how messy this dorm is*
